decisions.reason: The cross-platform tutorial localization strategy is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.

The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording reusable background-only tutorial assets and separately rendered translatable text; its remote-delivery strategy remains compatible and unchanged.
The size-related tutorial asset optimization is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no stale attribute requiring removal.
The cross-platform asset-size strategy is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no additional update or removal required.
Separating translatable tutorial text from background assets does not change the existing requirement that layouts render correctly in right-to-left locales.
The tutorial localization architecture does not alter the iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial asset and text-rendering strategy does not affect the requirement to supply an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial localization strategy has no effect on iOS signing certificates or signing configuration.
The tutorial asset and translatable-text design does not change Android platform compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial localization strategy does not affect the policy to remove unused Android permissions or the identified READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
